description: Index of independent AI-agent, machine-learning, citizen-science, and open-source exoplanet discovery projects and notable candidates (2018-2026).

projects.name: Pavel Rabtsevich — AI-Assisted TESS Vetting & Preregistered DDT #100
projects.summary: Independent researcher used Claude Code and Codex in an adversarial falsification loop (74 analyses, 1,000+ scripts, leave-one-year-out prediction across 2018/2020/2025, 36 catalogs + 340,505 TESS alerts cross-checked) to identify a 3.1828 d (~1.4 R_earth) candidate and tentative 11.1328 d (~2.2 R_earth) signal around the nearby K dwarf TIC 4206066 (StKM 1-561, 35.6 pc). Approved for NASA TESS Director's Discretionary Time (DDT Program #100) in Sector 110 (Oct 31 - Nov 26, 2026) with preregistered transit times and decision rules.

projects.name: RAVEN (RAnking and Validation of ExoplaNets) — University of Warwick
projects.summary: Machine learning validation pipeline applied to 2.2 million stars in TESS Years 1-4 Full-Frame Images (FFIs). Statistically validated 118 new exoplanets (including 31 previously unreported discoveries) and ranked over 2,000 high-quality candidates.

projects.name: ExoMiner & ExoMiner++ — NASA Ames Research Center
projects.summary: Deep learning classifier trained on Kepler and TESS Data Validation (DV) products. Validated 370+ Kepler planets and identified ~7,000 exoplanet candidates in TESS multi-sector TCE catalogs.

projects.name: Princeton T16 Survey — 83.7M TESS Year-1 FFI Stars
projects.summary: Semi-automated ML survey of 83,717,159 stars down to T=16 in TESS Year-1 Full-Frame Images, identifying 11,554 exoplanet candidates (10,091 previously unreported, 1,052 known TOIs, 411 single-transit events) and confirming hot Jupiter TIC 183374187 b via Magellan radial velocities.

projects.name: Planet Hunters TESS (PHT) & Citizen Science Vetting Ecosystem
tools: LATTE (Lightcurve Analysis Tool for Transiting Exoplanets)
projects.summary: Global citizen-science project inspecting TESS light curves for single-transit, long-period, circumbinary, and multi-star signals missed by automated BLS/TPS pipelines. Notable discoveries include TOI-1338 b (circumbinary planet), TOI-813 b, HD 152843 b/c, TOI-4633 c ('Percival'), TOI-791 b/c, and compact triple-star system TIC 290061484.

projects.name: SHERLOCK (Searching for Hints of Exoplanets fRom Light curves Of spaCe-based seeKers)
projects.summary: Community open-source end-to-end Python pipeline for multi-detrend transit searching, vetting, and statistical validation on TESS/Kepler light curves. Used to discover the TOI-2267 3-planet compact binary system and numerous M-dwarf candidates.

projects.name: Open-Source Independent TESS Hunters on GitHub (2025-2026)
projects.summary: Independent open-source repositories automating multi-sector TESS light-curve stitching, upward-only MAD flare clipping, BLS-to-TLS two-stage period narrowing, odd/even depth tests, and ExoFOP TOI/CTOI cross-referencing.
